# New Disney+ Pricing: What You'll Pay and How Much More

By WDWMAGIC Staff· Wednesday September 23, 2026 12:44pm ET·"Disney+"

 View 3 photos

WDWMAGIC+

 Disney+ prices have risen across most plans as of September 23, 2026. Premium tiers jumped 13.2%, while existing subscribers keep their current rate until October 21, 2026.

 Disney+ prices have risen across most plans as of September 23, 2026. Premium tiers jumped 13.2%, while existing subscribers keep their current rate until October 21, 2026. 

Photos / 3 in this gallery

 

Disney has raised prices on several Disney+ and bundle subscription plans. 

The Disney+ price increase applies to new subscriptions starting today, September 23, 2026. If you already have a Disney+ subscription, the new pricing will show up in your billing cycle on or after October 21, 2026.

### New Disney+ Pricing and Percentage Increases

Here's what changed, including how much each plan went up by percentage:

- Disney+ (With Ads): $12.49, up from $11.99 — a 4.2% increase
- Disney+ Premium Monthly (No Ads): $21.49, up from $18.99 — a 13.2% increase
- Disney+ Premium Annual (No Ads): $214.99, up from $189.99 — a 13.2% increase
- Disney+, Hulu Bundle Premium (No Ads): $21.99, up from $19.99 — a 10% increase
- Disney+, Hulu, HBO Max Bundle (With Ads): $21.99, up from $19.99 — a 10% increase
- Disney+, Hulu, HBO Max Bundle (No Ads): $34.99, up from $32.99 — a 6.1% increase

The Premium plans, both monthly and annual, saw the largest percentage jump at over 13%. The ad-supported Disney+ plan had the smallest increase, at just over 4%.

### When You'll See the Change

New subscribers pay the updated prices right away. If you're a current subscriber, your rate stays the same until your next billing cycle on or after October 21, 2026. Check your account settings for your exact renewal date so you know when the new price takes effect.

Mar 05, 2026

The Disney+, Hulu, ESPN Bundle includes Disney+, Hulu, and ESPN for one price. Interested in bundling your subscriptions? Find all the details you need to get started.

You can choose to bundle all three streaming services, or just Disney+ and Hulu, depending on the plan you sign up for. To learn more about each service, select from the list below.

Disney+: Watch all your favorite movies and TV shows from Disney, Pixar, Marvel, Star Wars, and National Geographic. From new releases to your favorite classics and exclusive Originals, there's something for everyone.

Hulu: Watch on-demand shows and movies, including full seasons of exclusive series, current TV hits, past seasons, movies, Hulu Originals, kids shows, and more. Bundle subscribers can stream Hulu content directly on the Hulu app or website, in addition to select content available through Hulu via the Disney+ app or website.

ESPN Select: With an ESPN Select subscription, you can expect to see content from the ESPN+ library. Watch thousands of live sporting events, the complete 30 for 30 library, and on-demand sports content that includes games, news highlights, ESPN Originals and more. You can stream directly on the ESPN app or access content on the Disney+ and Hulu apps.*

ESPN Unlimited: Watch everything included with ESPN Select, plus live access to all of ESPN’s networks and services – including ESPN and ESPN 2 – in addition to ESPN on ABC sporting events. You can stream directly on the ESPN app or access content on the Disney+ and Hulu apps.*

# Disney+ Plans Compared: Every Plan, Bundle and Add-on Price, October 2026

Disney+ is $12.49 with ads, Premium $21.49 or $214.99 a year, the Hulu bundle $12.99 or $21.99, ESPN bundles to $44.99, NFL+ bundles $45.99 up. Every price on one page.

Published Oct 11, 2026 Checked against official sources · last verified Oct 11, 2026 · how we verify

Disney+ has two plans of its own and nine more that wrap it with Hulu, ESPN, HBO Max or NFL+. As of October 10, 2026, Disney+‘s plans and prices page lists Disney+ (With Ads) at $12.49 a month, Disney+ Premium at $21.49 a month or $214.99 a year, the Disney+, Hulu Bundle at $12.99 or $21.99, the ESPN bundles from $21.99 to $44.99, the HBO Max bundles at $21.99 or $34.99, and two NFL+ Premium bundles at $45.99 and $54.99. These are the prices for new subscriptions since September 23, 2026; the page says anyone who signed up earlier sees the change “in your billing cycle on or after October 21, 2026.” This guide puts every price on one page, works out the arithmetic Disney’s page does not, and notes where the page is silent. If you are leaving, the billing paths are in our Disney+ cancellation guide.

## The quick answer

- Disney+ (With Ads): $12.49 a month, no annual option listed
- Disney+ Premium (No Ads): $21.49 a month, or $214.99 a year ($17.92 a month by our math)
- Disney+, Hulu Bundle: $12.99 with ads, $21.99 with no ads on both, 50 cents over Disney+ alone
- With ESPN: $21.99 or $32.99 with ESPN Select, $35.99 or $44.99 with ESPN Unlimited
- With HBO Max: $21.99 with ads, $34.99 with no ads, direct billing only
- With NFL+ Premium: $45.99 or $54.99, on the ESPN Unlimited bundles only
- Extra Member: $6.99 to $14.99 a month depending on plan
- Free trial: none. “Please note that Disney+ does not currently offer a free trial.”

## Key facts at a glance

| Disney+, Hulu Bundle | With ads | $12.99 | Not listed | Hulu with ads |
| Disney+, Hulu Bundle Premium | No ads | $21.99 | Not listed | Hulu no ads |
| Disney+, Hulu, ESPN Select Bundle | With ads | $21.99 | Not listed | Hulu and ESPN Select, with ads |
| Disney+, Hulu, ESPN Select Bundle Premium | No ads | $32.99 | Not listed | Hulu no ads, ESPN Select with ads |
| Disney+, Hulu, ESPN Unlimited Bundle | With ads | $35.99 | Not listed | Hulu and ESPN Unlimited, with ads |
| Disney+, Hulu, ESPN Unlimited Bundle Premium | No ads | $44.99 | Not listed | Hulu no ads, ESPN Unlimited with ads |
| Disney+, Hulu, HBO Max Bundle (With Ads) | With ads | $21.99 | Not listed | Hulu and HBO Max Basic, with ads |
| Disney+, Hulu, HBO Max Bundle (No Ads) | No ads | $34.99 | Not listed | Hulu Premium, HBO Max Standard |
| ESPN Unlimited Bundle with NFL+ Premium | With ads | $45.99 | Not listed | Hulu, ESPN Unlimited, NFL+ Premium |
| ESPN Unlimited Bundle Premium with NFL+ Premium | No ads | $54.99 | Not listed | Hulu no ads, ESPN Unlimited, NFL+ Premium |

Prices from Disney+‘s plans and prices page, read October 10, 2026, for new subscriptions. One legacy plan, Disney+ Premium, Hulu, ESPN Select Bundle Legacy at $27.99, is listed for existing subscribers only. Disney’s page notes that third-party billing partners may price differently.

## The two Disney+ plans, and the one annual price

Disney+ (With Ads), $12.49 a month. The feature list is three lines: “Supports up to 5.1 audio,” “Experience video quality in up to 4K UHD & HDR,” and “Stream on multiple devices at a time.” There is no annual price for this plan on the page.
